paragraphs.en: FxEmbed is a Cloudflare Worker, so the Docker image runs the local Workers runtime through Wrangler rather than starting a plain Node.js server. The image uses node:24-bookworm-slim because Wrangler's workerd binary is glibc-linked and does not run reliably on Alpine/musl.
paragraphs.zh: FxEmbed 是一个 Cloudflare Worker，因此 Docker 镜像通过 Wrangler 运行本地的 Workers 运行时，而不是启动一个普通的 Node.js 服务器。 该镜像使用 node:24-bookworm-slim，因为 Wrangler 的 workerd 二进制文件链接的是 glibc，无法在 Alpine/musl 上可靠地运行。

sents.en: FxEmbed is a Cloudflare Worker, so the Docker image runs the local Workers runtime through Wrangler rather than starting a plain Node.js server.
sents.zh: FxEmbed 是一个 Cloudflare Worker，因此 Docker 镜像通过 Wrangler 运行本地的 Workers 运行时，而不是启动一个普通的 Node.js 服务器。

paragraphs.en: Before building, copy and edit the local configuration files if you need custom domains, branding, or credentials:
paragraphs.zh: 构建之前，如果需要自定义域名、品牌标识或凭据，请复制并编辑本地配置文件：

paragraphs.en: cp .env.example .env cp wrangler.example.toml wrangler.toml cp branding.example.json branding.json Build and run with Docker Compose:
paragraphs.zh: cp .env.example .env cp wrangler.example.toml wrangler.toml cp branding.example.json branding.json 使用 Docker Compose 构建并运行：

paragraphs.en: docker compose up -d --build The worker listens on http://localhost:8787 . Because FxEmbed routes by the Host header, test a specific realm like this:
paragraphs.zh: docker compose up -d --build 该 worker 监听 http://localhost:8787 。 由于 FxEmbed 根据 Host 请求头进行路由，请按如下方式测试特定领域：

sents.en: docker compose up -d --build The worker listens on http://localhost:8787 .
sents.zh: docker compose up -d --build 该 worker 监听 http://localhost:8787 。

sents.en: Because FxEmbed routes by the Host header, test a specific realm like this:
sents.zh: 由于 FxEmbed 根据 Host 请求头进行路由，请按如下方式测试特定领域：

paragraphs.en: curl -H " Host: fxtwitter.com " -H " User-Agent: Discordbot/2.0 " " http://localhost:8787/user/status/123 " You can also open http://localhost:8787/ without a Host header to see the local realm prefixes.
paragraphs.zh:
```bash
curl -H "Host: fxtwitter.com" -H "User-Agent: Discordbot/2.0" "http://localhost:8787/user/status/123"
```

你也可以不携带 Host 头直接打开 http://localhost:8787/ 来查看本地域前缀。

paragraphs.en: Environment variables from .env are bundled during the Docker build, so rebuild the image after changing domain lists or other build-time configuration:
paragraphs.zh: 来自 .env 的环境变量会在 Docker 构建过程中打包进去，因此在更改域名列表或其他构建时配置后，需要重新构建镜像。

paragraphs.en: docker compose up -d --build Runtime secrets such as CREDENTIAL_KEY and EXCEPTION_DISCORD_WEBHOOK can be supplied through your shell or Compose .env file. Stop the service with:
paragraphs.zh: docker compose up -d --build 诸如 CREDENTIAL_KEY 和 EXCEPTION_DISCORD_WEBHOOK 之类的运行时密钥可以通过 shell 或 Compose 的 .env 文件提供。停止服务请使用：
